slides.title: Negative inversion (introduction)
slides.subtitle: Never have I… / Not only…but also
goals: Use it for emphasis in formal speech and writing.

slides.title: Common patterns

head: Adverbial
Example
rows: **Never have I seen** such a mess.
**Not only is he** smart, **but** he is **also** kind.
**Hardly had we** arrived **when** it started to rain.
**Under no circumstances should you** open this.

slides.tip: After the negative adverb, use **question word order**: auxiliary + subject.

items.q: Not only ___ the exam, but she got the best score.
